errors.evidence: The x-axis displays years but does not have the explicit label "Jahr".

errors.text_span: und reicht von 1970 bis 2022 in Fünfjahresschritten
errors.evidence: The axis labels range from 1970 to 2020. The data extends beyond 2020, but the axis itself is not labeled up to 2022.

errors.text_span: Zwischen 1985 und 1995 fällt sie auf etwa 2,6%
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the value falls to about 2.6% between 1985 and 1995. In reality, the value falls from about 2.8% in 1985 to about 1.8% in 1995.

errors.text_span: Sie bleibt bis etwa 2010 weitgehend stabil
errors.evidence: The line shows a noticeable downward trend between 2000 (approx. 1.6%) and 2010 (approx. 1.4%), not stability.

errors.text_span: und steigt bis etwa 1,5% im Jahr 2022 wieder leicht an
errors.evidence: The final value of the line, around 2022, is approximately 1.7%, not 1.5% as stated.
The horizontal line at 2% is dashed (gestrichelt), not dotted (gepunktet).
